note: Pure integer arithmetic candidates; avoid metadata-only differences and forbidden constructs.

tasks.instruction: Improve integer temporary lifetimes, truncation scheduling and equivalent expression forms. Preserve Int(1) then Int(2) call order and exact result for every integer. No static_cast, unsigned(...) functional casts or new helpers; permitted casts are u8,u32,int,bool. Do not merely rename variables.
tasks.context: CodeWarrior Wii uses 32-bit unsigned long and u32, 8-bit u8. DataArray::Int returns signed int; converting to unsigned is modulo 2^32. DataNode(kDataInt, integer) constructs integer result; implicit integer return is equivalent. u8 truncates modulo256. Logical not ! is boolean 0/1. Preserve distinction logical ! versus bitwise ~. Original rotate macros OP_ROT_L and OP_ROT_R mask shift distances with31 and final value255; no shifts by32 or more. Preserve all original masks/constants and sequence of reads. Matching is judged by original instruction stream, not just semantic equivalence.
